title: 6th Sitting of First session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/6/1/2026).

Question time: a written question from North Galolhu MP Mohamed Ibrahim to the Minister of Health, Abdulla Nazim Ibrahim, asking why a national blood service system at health facilities and a register of blood donors for thalassaemia children have still not been set up as required by the Health Services Act and the Thalassaemia Control Act, and why no modern solution has been found for the difficulties in obtaining and giving blood.
Preliminary debate on the Bill to amend the Maldives Land Act (Law No. 1/2002), submitted by North Galolhu MP Mohamed Ibrahim.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the National Service Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by South Kulhudhuffushi MP Faruhath Mohamed.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to take a written health question on blood services for thalassaemia patients, begin debate on a Land Act amendment, and continue debating the National Service Bill.
